{"metadata":{"description":"A typed runtime for long-lived, plugin-oriented Rust applications — lifecycle, exact service placement, typed events, deterministic cleanup, scopes, and isolation.","id":"gh:1335001737","install_available":false,"language":"Rust","name":"cordis-rs","slug":"dshbox/cordis-rs","topics":["cordis","deepseek-harness","dependency-injection","dsh-plugin","events","plugin-framework","port","rust"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A typed runtime for long-lived, plugin-oriented Rust applications — lifecycle, exact service placeme"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"nt, typed events, deterministic cleanup, scopes, and isolation."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Cordis"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Cordis is a typed runtime for long-lived, plugin-oriented Rust applications.
It gives application co"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"mponents one model for lifecycle, service dependencies,
typed events, resource cleanup, and explicit"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" isolation boundaries."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Cordis is useful when your program is more than a collection of short-lived
function calls: plugins "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"can appear and disappear, services can become available
or unavailable, configuration can change, an"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"d runtime resources must still be

critical bug and security fixes. The v3 transition is intentionally breaking;
see `MIGRATION.md` "},{"id":"p17s4","text":"and `docs/v3-migration.md`."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## The mental model"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Five types carry most of the public model:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- **`Context`** — a cheap immutable view into one Cordis Runtime.
- **`Plugin`** — reusable behavior"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" with typed source configuration and runtime input.
- **`FiberHandle`** — the lifecycle handle for o"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"ne admitted non-root Fiber.
- **`Service`** — a typed, named capability published into an exact serv"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"ice realm.
- **`Event`** — a typed runtime communication contract with explicit routing."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"A Plugin enters the Runtime through a deliberate boundary:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"`prepare()` runs before lifecycle admission. `spawn()` is the first operation
allowed to create Runt"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ime lifecycle state."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The smallest complete flow is: define an Event, define a Plugin, prepare and
spawn it, dispatch the "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"Event, then explicitly dispose the returned FiberHandle."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Run the repository's complete version with:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Lifecycle and convergence"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"A successful `Context::spawn()` returns a `FiberHandle` only after the new Fiber has
settled for the"},{"id":"p30s2","text":" current service snapshot. The stable result is normally:"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- **Active** — all required Services are available and `apply()` succeeded.
- **Pending** — a requir"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"ed Service is currently unavailable; `apply()` has not run."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Requirements are declared with `InjectSpec`. They are lifecycle prerequisites,
not constructor injec"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"tion. When an exact required Service publication appears or
disappears, Cordis converges affected Fi"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"bers toward their new stable state."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"A `FiberHandle` exposes the main lifecycle operations:"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"- `ready()` waits for the current stable state.
- `restart()` reapplies the current committed input "},{"id":"p34s2","text":"on the same Fiber.
- `update(PreparedChange)` attempts a precommit-controlled typed input replacemen"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"t; a committed update keeps the same Fiber.
- `era_swap(PreparedChange)` performs identity-breaking "},{"id":"p34s4","text":"replacement; a successful successor has a fresh Fiber identity.
- `dispose()` ends the Fiber and run"},{"id":"p34s5","text":" successful successor has a fresh Fiber identity.
- `dispose()` ends the Fiber and runs its cleanup."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"Dropping a `FiberHandle` does **not** dispose the Fiber. Lifecycle ownership is explicit."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"Resources registered through a Plugin's apply `Context` are owned by that apply
generation. Listener"},{"id":"p36s2","text":" registrations, Service publications, tasks, effects, and
timer operations can therefore be cleaned "},{"id":"p36s3","text":"up with the generation instead of
being manually threaded through application code."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"## Application teardown"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"Cordis deliberately has no Runtime-wide shutdown API. Applications retain the
delivered `FiberHandle"},{"id":"p38s2","text":"`s they intend to end and call `dispose().await` during
normal shutdown. The demonstrated example Ha"},{"id":"p38s3","text":"rness records handles in spawn order
and disposes them in reverse spawn order, attempt-all; that ord"},{"id":"p38s4","text":"ering is
application policy, not a hidden Fiber parent/child relation."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"Dropping a `FiberHandle` or `Context` is ordinary Rust Drop, not lifecycle teardown,
and root-owned "},{"id":"p39s2","text":"registrations do not disappear merely because Context clones are
dropped. See Application teardown f"},{"id":"p39s3","text":"or the
complete demonstrated pattern, including repeated teardown, generation cleanup,
and Loader ha"},{"id":"p39s4","text":"demonstrated pattern, including repeated teardown, generation cleanup,
